notes.title: 1.18 Christmas 2022 Update
notes.content:
Welcome to our 1.18 update in time for the holiday season - this update features a limited-time holiday inspired game mode, along with the introduction of Harmony and SimulatorFM stations to the game's radio! Thank you to the community who have provided feedback via livestreams and on our social media channels! Please continue to report bugs or provide suggestions (via the Options Menu) or through our Discord server.

https://i.imgur.com/u63zMs9.png

Christmas Delivery Game Mode
Deliver the Christmas gifts from all the residents of the local town in a fun and relaxed puzzle-style game mode. Find all 14 gifts and deliver each gift to the houses in the snowy-filled town! You can find it from the 'Career Modes' menu from the title screen!

https://i.imgur.com/0UkI3lw.png
Personalise your company name and identity at the start of the game mode to feel at home in your own custom warehouse experience! The logo will be displayed around the warehouse - look out for it!

https://i.imgur.com/HTTBYQL.png
Deliver all the gifts to the town to light up the building decorations!

https://i.imgur.com/ncNiY4G.png
Instead of delivering specific packages, you'll need to find the gift boxes hidden around the warehouse since the Roomba-Bots got mis-programmed and froze down in the snowy temperatures.

Update Notes
Career
- Added 'Christmas Delivery' game mode, accessible from the title screen

Cosmetics
- Added 'Giftbox', 'Holiday Duck' and 'Snowman' cosmetic hats
- Added 'Harmony' and 'SimulatorFM' cosmetic stickers.

Radio:
-Addition of Harmony Radio.
-Addition of SimulatorFM Radio.
-Removal of Hype station (due to loss of server connection, and no contact/information regarding their shutdown relayed to development team)

Misc:
-Credits updated

notes.title: V1.17 Update - Free Forklift Drivers Update
notes.content:
Welcome to our 1.17 update, which finally includes our brand new in-game characters which we announced a few weeks back. Saint George, Dr Plaster, Minoru, Clover and Maple are ready to drive the forklifts in your arcade gamemode, FREE to play today! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37648563/d275d5708fd692e2fc7fb322986832f93ee85fc5.png

We have also joined forces with our friends at Heartbeatz Radio and Hype Radio, meaning you can now listen to their awesome simulation stations directly in-game (press 'R' to use the radio in-game)!

Characters

 Introduction of Saint George, Dr Plaster, Minoru, Farmer Clover and Chef Maple! New main-menu option to allow you to select the drivers.

Radio

 Addition of Heartbeatz Radio.
 Addition of Hype Radio.

notes.title: 2022 Forklift Drivers Update - Initial Announcement
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=vfBv4i_WYVw;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello forklift drivers!

Today, we are excited to announce the introduction of five new playable character joining the Amazing warehouse team, in an update coming late 2022. Saint George, Dr Plaster, Minoru, Farmer Clover and Chef Maple will be the first set of characters who will be selectable as drivers in the career levels. They will be available to play in an free update planned for September-October after the conclusion of a satisfactory QA phase. A talented cast have joined the development of the game to voice our new characters, with their work set to feature throughout the menus and career levels while driving throughout the in-game days.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37648563/7e132ea4ca02454cfab20448acdc33d390477417.png

Saint George
A masterful and skillful knight, Saint George is a man who led his army of soldiers through a dark and distressing eight year war against the Roman Empire. A man with a leading individual who is faithful to his team, works with pride and honour. Seth Jones brings a strong voice to the character; he has recently featured in the English-dubbed version of Attack On Titan.

Doctor Plaster, Ph.D
Doctor Plaster is your caring, respectful and confident medical practitioner/physician. A well-educated and knowledgeable individual, who provides self-assurance, informative and friendly remarks throughout the gameplay. Matthew Kreta provides Dr Plaster's voice - he has also featured on the fan-made Danganronpa: Despair Time video series and the visual novel Ringo Fortune (Sarchalen Team).


Minoru
Originating from Askahori, Minoru is a quick-minded, responsible and fast-paced individual. His next move is unpredictable; projecting humorous but puzzling quotes to keep the player guessing and learning about him. Alejandro Arias voices this youthful character - he has worked on various internet cartoons and shorts (Cartoon Cafe, Team Teen, Mari & Jouzo) along with appearances in Fate of WINDSHIFT (REAL Co.Ltd) and Dislyte (Lilith Games).


Farmer Clover
An individual from a rural township, Farmer Clover works on her local farm managing her ranches of cows, chickens and horses. She's strong, angry and not afraid to fight for her work. Veronica Laux brings a wealth of experience to the role, voicing characters for various anime shows and visual novels including Aharen-san wa hakarenai (Felix Film), The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn as a Typical Nobody (Comikey), ALLBLACK Phase 1 (NSAID) and Potion Commotion (NerdyBird Studios).


Chef Maple
A proud and confident lead chef in a successful restaurant in her hometown, Maple is an excited and hopeful individual who enjoys showing off her work and is excited to cook and provide a high quality service to her customers. Voiced by Sierra Lipe, who has featured in Danganronpa: Gods at Gunpoint (deimosatellite) and Hyper Custom Night (TheImpossibleMode).

notes.title: 1.16.2 Patch Update - Minor bug fixing and polish
notes.content:
Welcome to our 1.16.2 update, which addresses issues with arcade gameplay, controller support, and gameplay settings. Thank you to the community who have provided feedback via livestreams and on our social media channels! Please continue to report bugs or provide suggestions (via the Options Menu) or through our Discord server.

Controller Input

Fixed issue with controllers failing to recognize acceleration/braking inputs in any driving states.


Arcade:

Fixed issue causing the level 'The Pandemic' (Level B3) to not correctly execute due to a previous engine upgrade.
Fixed issue where ghosts were not spawning in 'Deserted Prince' (Level D2), causing 'Spooky Scary' achievement to be unreachable. 
Updates to the environment in 'Beach Ball Bonanza!' (Level D3) and 'Back Of The Net!' (E1).


Misc UI/UX

Fixed options menu auto-displaying when entering Pause Menu, removed depreciated key bind options for future content.
Adjustment to forklift textures; custom-coloured forklifts use an improved Forklift base texture to make colour choice appear visually richer.
UI Improvements on the Tutorial's tablets, and licence screen
Reddit social page added to the title screen.
Addressing minor issues relating to scaling of user-interface
Addressing issues relating to screen resolution not loading on game launch, and failing to save correctly.


Stay up to date on our official platforms: Discord / Twitter / Facebook / Twitch / Reddit

notes.title: 1.16.1 Patch Update - Minor bug fixing and polish
notes.content:
Welcome to our 1.16.1 update, which includes a range of fixes in some Arcade levels and the online Multiplayer servers. Thanks to our fantastic community for noting the bugs and the ongoing support! Please continue to report bugs or provide suggestions (via the Options Menu) or through our Discord server.

Multiplayer

Improvements to collisions on the Farmdale barn and surrounding areas
Improvements to collisions to ensure packages do not get stuck under the shelving units
Fixed inconsistency of Stockport region names between the map and tablet UI.
Radio system has been disabled due to server-wide issues this enabled.
Added player name indicators.


Arcade

Fixed various issues in the 'On The Farm' (Level C3) level due to a previous engine upgrade. The pineapple crates removed entirely; addition of lids to the fruit crates; various code-side optimisations.
Restored missing AI functionality within Our House (Level A2), The Applicance (A3), Be A Good Sport (D1) and Deserted Prince (D2)
Grass texture updated within Back Of The Net (E1)


Overworld area for Arcade

Environment in the Overworld area has been tidied up. Beach Ball Bonanza and Back Of The Net levels have been moved to usual shelving units (at D3 and E1).
Improvements to collisions to ensure packages do not get stuck under the shelving units
UI improvements to the level selection list on the tablet.



Stay up to date on our official platforms: Discord / Twitter / Facebook / Twitch / Reddit

notes.title: 1.16 Update - Multiplayer restored, minor bug fixing
notes.content:
Welcome to our 1.16 update, which fixes several bugs noted over the past few weeks! As you may have noticed, our Career Mode has been revamped into an Arcade mode, in preparation for a new career-focused game mode we look to introduce later this spring! More news on that to come! All Arcade Levels are now unlocked, multiplayer servers have been restored, and a general polish up of the menus! Please continue to report bugs or provide suggestions (via the Options Menu) or through our Discord server.

Cosmetics

 Removal of 'Fidget Spinner', 'Guitar' and 'Robin Hood' cosmetic hats, as a result of engine updates.
 Cosmetic paintwork, hats and stickers will be exclusive for Arcade Mode.


Main Menu

 Updated user-interfaces for Career, Multiplayer, Rumba-Racing, Garage submenus, and additional UI elements cleaned up in the Main Menu.
 Fix for minor bug where cosmetic stickers would not fully clear.
 Updated visual layout of Credits screen.


Internal systems

 Upgraded engine to Unity 2021.2.4f1.
 Transferred to Steamworks.NET 15.0.1 library for improved Steam integration.
 Updated rich presence for Discord/Steam integrations.
 Updates to internal radio system to run directly in-game instead of an external process.
 Addition of SimulatorVibes radio station, and updates to TruckStopRadio and Simuator Radio logos.

notes.title: Update for V1.15
notes.content:
Hey players! We've pushed a little update to do some cleaning up and some small bug fixing! 

We are also in the early development stages of a new game mode, which we plan to release towards the end of 2021, which we hope will bring some more replay-ability to Forking Hell too! Keep up to date on our socials as always to show the love, report any issues or suggest ideas or new cosmetics!


 Cleaner menus and UIs - several text displays in the Main Menu have been cleaned up for readability!
 Additional cosmetics - some new horn sounds and a large range of stickers (including many countries and identities) allow you to continue to personalise your forklift.
 TSR's radio stream updated


Stay safe and keep up the good work at the Amazing warehouse!

notes.title: Forking Hell Major Halloween Update - October 2020
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37648563/51e2dbe0523e7a9072c6a883898262fa760ff7bf.png

I am delighted to announce a major update to Forking Hell which sees the addition of seasonal content, 
new permanent features and the launch of Forking Hell multiplayer.

Seasonal Content

🎃We know Halloween won't be as good this year, so why not go Treat Or Treating in our seasonal game mode, which lets you deliver candy products to the neighbourhood.
🌛Temporary celebrations, to let you work in the Amazing warehouses at night-time for the spookiness of the season.

Multiplayer
👥 Our most requested feature was multiplayer! Now you can hop on a server with your friends or with others in the community to drive around and haul cargo around the local city in an open-world style format.

Permanent features
📷 New camera angles give you more opportunities to look around the warehouses while sitting in your vehicle!
📻 Add custom radio stations to listen to any internet radio stations within your local game! Simply add your favourite station name and URLs to the txt file in your Documents and load up the game to listen directly in-game!
📃Squad up in Forking Hell Clubs - your chance to group up and join a virtual warehouse company to share stats and play together!
🎮Keyboard keybindings allow you to change the default keyboard and mouse input to personalise your in-game experience. Controller and other gamepad inputs will not fully work for now, but we will continue to work towards this.
🎨 New garage additions let you customise your forklift vehicle even more - change the colour, add cosmetic stickers or alter the vehicle's horn.

📞

notes.title: Radios Update - July 2020
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the arrival of five enjoyable and high quality internet radio stations, which are live to listen to during your forklift career!

To listen to any of our radio stations, load up any career level and press the Radio key (R on keyboard, X on Xbox controller).

Introducing our radio line-up
British based radio Bounce founded in 2020 are in the final stages of their setup, and approached our development team earlier this month regarding involvement. We are delighted to help provide listeners for this recently-founded team!

Hive365 are recognised for their involvement of community servers of Counter-Strike, Left 4 Dead, Team Fortress 2, GMod and Minecraft. We are proud to feature their radio station which celebrated their seventh anniversary in 2020 and continue to rise in the gaming community.

Founded in April 2020, SimulatorHits supply a variety of music on-air with focus on the simulation genre of games. We are excited to join up with their community. 

Simulator Radio initially approached our development team prior to Forking Hell's release. Originally opening in 2014 under the name EuroTruckRadio, they have expanded into a large gaming community with a combined social media backing of over 15k followers. Without their support, the radio feature would not have been possible! The radio was always in the game, but this is our chance to introduce their community and thank them for their support.

Truck Stop Radio is a fully community-ran online radio station also aimed at the simulation community with their launch in May of 2020 - it's great to work with you guys, also!

Update notes and housecleaning notes
A huge thank you to all of the communities who have provided their development support and input over the past few weeks ahead of our recent update. Update 1.05.1 also includes numerous bug fixes, including level selection/saving issues, and Steam achievement issues for some levels. We are always looking for feedback, bug reports, suggestions and idea, and we will continue to plan ahead for seasonal content this October and December!

notes.title: Forking Hell - NOW LIVE
notes.content:
https://pbs.twimg.com/media/Ebt_EZ-WkAAeja2?format=png&name=900x900

We are delighted to announce that Forking Hell is officially available for you to purchase and download today. Stepping up from our demo released in May, our new product includes multiple levels of forklift driving chaos, a collection of minigames, and the ability to customise your vehicle in the garage. We will always open to watch streams and YouTube videos, and we will work with the community for bug fixes, future level concepts and possible features to shape future updates.

Thank you to Simulator Radio for their continued support during our release week, and to all of the players getting involved with the game.

Buy it today from the Steam Store, and keep in touch with us through our Discord and social media platforms:

 Twitter
 Facebook
 Discord
